queryTypes.description: Look up or search objects of one stereotype. A lookup finds one object by its identifier (has anchor). A search finds objects matching filters (has filters). Exactly one of anchor or filters must be present.

anchor.description: Lookup only. {"identifier": "<identifier exactly as the user typed it>"}, e.g. {"identifier": "SREQ 123"}.

columns.description: Attribute names the user asked to see. Leave out when the user names no fields.

filters.description: Search only. List of {"attribute", "operator", "value"}. Leave attribute out of a CONTAINS_ANY or CONTAINS_ALL filter when the user names no field.

examples.question: Give me Data tag, data status for DATA-123
Give me the SREQs that contain 'Date of Birth' or 'Birth Date' or 'DOB'
Give me use cases whose comments contain 'DOB'
Give me the SREQs that mention both 'passport' and 'expiry'

queryTypes.description: List the business attributes (fields) available for a stereotype. Answered from metadata; no SQL is built.

examples.question: Give me column names of SREQ
